# Kisan Mitra (किसान मित्र)
> AI-Powered Smart Agricultural Companion & Decision Intelligence Platform for Farmers

## Overview
Kisan Mitra is a full-stack agritech progressive web application engineered to bridge technology and agriculture for Indian farmers. The platform combines visual AI plant pathology, geospatial epidemiological surveillance, meteorological harvest window modeling, real-time APMC agricultural mandi pricing, and multilingual voice-driven intelligence.

## Core Capabilities
- **Crop Doctor (Plant Pathology AI)**: Multimodal deep learning visual diagnostic tool that accepts leaf and crop photographs, identifies fungal/bacterial/viral infections with confidence metrics, categorizes severity, and outputs localized agrochemical and organic remedy recommendations.
- **Outbreak Radar (Epidemiological Surveillance)**: Interactive Leaflet geospatial map visualizing verified regional crop pest and disease outbreaks with district-level risk clustering and preventive advisories.
- **Harvest Guardian (Meteorological & Agronomic Planning)**: Real-time 7-day weather synthesis correlating humidity, precipitation risk, and crop maturity to calculate optimal harvest windows.
- **Market Copilot (APMC Mandi Price Intelligence)**: Live market pricing engine tracking minimum, maximum, and modal agricultural commodity prices across Indian state markets with historical trend charts.
- **Multilingual Support**: Real-time voice and text interaction available in English, Hindi (हिंदी), Malayalam (മലയാളം), and Tamil (தமிழ்).

## Technical Architecture
- **Frontend**: React 18, Vite 6, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, Recharts, Lucide Icons, Leaflet, React Leaflet.
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, SQLite (better-sqlite3), JWT authentication, bcryptjs, Multer file processing.
- **AI/ML Engine**: Google Gemini API for plant diagnosis and multilingual advisory synthesis.
- **Domain**: https://kisanmitra.in
